authorization: User requests rapid identification of the operator causing the layer32 error increase. Diagnosis only; no optimization or deployment.
scope: Replay only decoder layer index31 and optional final norm from frozen current/reference hidden_layer30 inputs. Do not load or execute the preceding31 layers or full8B model. Do not run logits/ACC/PPL.
data: Use all3 formal R006 documents with saved paired hidden_layer30 tensors, identified before reading outcomes. Preserve document IDs, token lengths, inputs and immutable source hashes. These are diagnostic cases, not a formal1024 causal population claim.

B: OUTPUT_ONLY reference arithmetic on saved REFERENCE input Hr

traces: Capture input, input RMSNorm, Q/K/V projection, RoPE, KV quantization/dequantized values, QK scores, attention softmax, PV, attention output projection, attention residual, post-attention RMSNorm, gate/up projections, SiLU, gated product, down projection, final residual, final model norm where feasible. metrics: Absolute error energy/RMSE and reference signal energy/RMS, relativeL2, max error and signal magnitudes at every named stage; distinguish changing denominator from growing absolute error
At common output, exact vector identity A-B=(A-C)+(C-B); report error norms and cross term, not subtraction of relative percentages
Residual additions: identity of input-error plus branch-error, energy and cross terms; cancellation in the signal may inflate relative error
Dynamic quantization code/shift changes, saturation/overflow, activation scales and changed-value fractions where they explain a stage jump
CURRENT versus OUTPUT_ONLY parity with saved R006 final hidden/metrics and prepared/KV witnesses where present
targeted_interventions: After primary traces, on each of the3 cases replace one suspect stage output with the reference-trajectory output of that same stage while recomputing all downstream quantities. Include up to6 high-level cuts spanning attention output/residual, post-attention norm, MLP gate/up, SiLU/gated product, down output and final norm as justified by actual trace. Where a family itself injects error, use same-input OUTPUT_ONLY arithmetic replacement to distinguish local rounding from inherited-error amplification. Report conditional effects, interactions and every tested arm; do not call a large intermediate relative error uniquely causal without downstream intervention.
implementation: Private R011 diagnostic wrappers and a single-block model assembled from original checkpoint weights and original V5 quantization; unmodified canonical arithmetic_context reference. No changes to production or consumed sources. R008's all32-layer runner is not authorized for this scope; only reuse its policy checks/helpers as needed.
verification: Saved input identities and layer index correct; baseline/reference reproduce frozen R006 data; hook coverage and state restoration verified; meaningful CPU checks and frozen-source GPU qualification before diagnosis.
